newsitem.title: USA: U.S. June S&Ps close higher but off record highs.
newsitem.headline: U.S. June S&Ps close higher but off record highs.

text.p: U.S. stock index futures ended mixed, with June Standard & Poor's 500s closing higher but off record peaks.

June S&Ps caught a strong bid in the pit at 842.50 and rallied to an all-time high of 846.50 on mid-month fund buying and options expiration-related buying, traders and analysts said. May options on futures expire at the start of pit trade on Friday.
"I don't know if I'm really impressed," Jay Hohmann, head trader of stock index products at Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities, said.
